place.summary: Tsim Sha Tsui functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong International Airport. Visitors often continue to Victoria Harbour.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Hong Kong International Airport
opportunity_cards.detail: Tsim Sha Tsui frequently appears alongside Hong Kong International Airport, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.
